WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune AS order_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM orderexecutions e
  JOIN orders o ON (e.ordersmark COLLATE BINARY) = (o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY)
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s.order_type, s.record_count,
         1.0 * s.record_count / t.total_count AS ratio
  FROM step1 s
  JOIN step2 t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s.order_type, s.record_count, s.ratio,
         s.ratio - a.average_ratio AS difference
  FROM step3 s
  JOIN step4 a ON a.average_ratio IS NOT NULL
  WHERE s.ratio > a.average_ratio
)
SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(difference) AS average_difference
FROM step5
